_doc: Catalog warehouse of the source datasets. For now each source gets its own warehouse in its own workspace, named catalog_warehouse_pattern (WH_CATALOG_<SOURCE>, catalog_warehouse_location = same_workspace). When the common warehouse exists, set catalog_warehouse_location = shared: every source then uses catalog_warehouse in shared_workspace. Each source has one view, [catalog_schema].[<source>_catalog]; VL_MAIN only holds where the view is: view name, warehouse name, ID, SQL endpoint, connection.
_doc_notebook_timeout: Timeout of the FLATTEN and RAW_TO_DELTA notebook activities (d.hh:mm:ss). A project can override it with notebook_timeout in progress.json project_inputs; regenerate S3 after a change.
